param.name: cachePool
param.comment: Trade cache pool: mk3 (traders) or mk4 (supply)

param.name: sellPriceMax
param.comment: Unused at write; per-ship band filter runs at cache read.

param.name: buyPriceMin
param.comment: Unused at write; per-ship band filter runs at cache read.

param.name: signalCacheUpdated
param.comment: When false, caller signals GT_MK4_Cache_Updated after its own post-write work (MK3 post-refresh).

set_value.name: $oldHasPermanentKeys
set_value.exact: (@$oldEntry.$Ware != null or @$oldEntry.$DeliveryStationName != null) and (@$oldEntry.$DeliveryStationId != null or @$oldEntry.$DeliveryStationName != null) and ((@$oldEntry.$SellSector != null and @$oldEntry.$SellSector.exists) or @$oldEntry.$SellSectorId != null or @$oldEntry.$DeliveryStationId != null)

set_value.name: $sellResolvable
set_value.exact: $oldHasLiveBase or $oldHasPermanentKeys or (@$oldEntry.$SellStation != null and @$oldEntry.$SellStation.exists) or (@$oldEntry.$SellOffer != null and @$oldEntry.$SellOffer.exists)

set_value.name: $oldReResolvable
set_value.exact: (@$oldEntry.$Ware != null or @$oldEntry.$DeliveryStationName != null) and (@$oldEntry.$DeliveryStationId != null or @$oldEntry.$DeliveryStationName != null) and ((@$oldEntry.$SellSector != null and @$oldEntry.$SellSector.exists) or @$oldEntry.$SellSectorId != null or @$oldEntry.$DeliveryStationId != null)

do_if.value: not $isStale and not $oldReResolvable and @$oldEntry.$SellOffer != null and not @$oldEntry.$SellOffer.exists
not $isStale and not $oldReResolvable and @$oldEntry.$SellStation != null and not @$oldEntry.$SellStation.exists

debug_text.text: '[GT-CacheWrite] ' + this.ship.idcode + ': (' + $poolLabel + ') Write-time cleanup removed ' + $expiredCount + ' expired/stale entries from ' + $homeSector.knownname + ' (remaining: ' + $remainingAfterCleanup + ')'

wait.comment: Yield while skipping at-cap low-score rows

do_while.value: ($shareCountBs gt $shareKeepBs or $shareCountSt gt $shareKeepSt or $shareCountAx gt $shareKeepAx) and $shareTrimGuard lt ($finalCacheSize + 1)

debug_text.text: '[GT-CacheWrite] ' + this.ship.idcode + ': (' + $poolLabel + ') Wrote ' + $tradeList.count + ' trades (sorted) into ' + $homeSector.knownname + ' cache (total: ' + $finalCacheSize + ', cleaned: ' + $expiredCount + ')'
